values.title: Every Jar is a Story
values.desc: We don't just pack jewellery — we pack a feeling. The thrill of not knowing, the joy of discovering, the smile when you open the jar.

values.title: Curated with Love
values.desc: Every single piece is handpicked by our mystery girl herself. If she wouldn't wear it, it doesn't go in the jar. Simple as that.

values.title: Magic is Real
values.desc: We believe in the magic of surprises. In a world of algorithms and recommendations, we bring back the joy of the unexpected.

values.title: Made for Every Woman
values.desc: Whether you're treating yourself or gifting someone you love — Jaraa is for every woman who deserves a little sparkle in her life.
